title: agentflow workflow
description: Workflow a plugin family declares for agentflow. Steps run in list order; a failed step with on_fail goes back to that earlier step, at most max_rounds times per task.

tiered_roles.description: Roles that have one agent per plan-item tier (<role>-fast, <role>-deep). Other roles have a single agent.

read_only_roles.description: Roles that only read. A project may grant them read-only tools (agentflow role grant) and nothing else.

agent_dirs.description: CLI -> folder, relative to this file, with that CLI's generated agent files (agentflow role grant copies them into the project).

sizes.description: Named task sizes. `agentflow task new --size <name>` picks one; the default applies when none is given. A profile can drop the approval of some steps, cap the number of plan items and limit which scan tools a step runs.

types.description: Task type (feature, bugfix, hotfix, refactor, chore) -> how tasks of that type differ. `test_spec: green` makes the test-spec step prove the tests pass on the code as it is (a change that keeps the behaviour) instead of failing first. `size: <profile>` is the size a task of that type gets when `--size` names none.

skip_approval.description: Steps that need no approval for tasks of this size (the step's gates still apply).

scans.description: Step id -> the scan tools (by id) that step runs for tasks of this size. Steps not listed run all their tools.

lock_on_approval.description: When a person approves this step, lock the files of its report (see lockfiles.py).

pin_docs_on_approval.description: When a person approves this step, keep the sha256 of the documents its report lists under '## Tài liệu' (see docpin.py).
